description: Defines the FileStream::Context class, including platform-dependent and platform-independent methods for managing file I/O operations asynchronously, with separation of platform-specific implementations and detailed internal state management.

classes.name: FileStream::Context
classes.description: Manages asynchronous file I/O operations with platform-specific implementations, including methods for reading, writing, opening, closing, seeking, and handling IO completion events.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data asynchronously into a buffer, with callback upon completion.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data asynchronously from a buffer, with callback upon completion.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a file with specified flags asynchronously.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified offset in the file asynchronously.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes buffered data to disk asynchronously.

methods.name: Orphan
methods.description: Destroys the context, deferring deletion if async operations are in progress.
